sources.snippet: The model architecture of MyAwesomeModel-Small is identical to its base model, but it shares the same tokenizer configuration as the main MyAwesomeModel. This model can be run in the same manner as its base model.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: my_awesome_model | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: my_awesome_model is a fine-tuned version of DistilBERT-base-uncased, specifically optimized for text classification tasks. The model demonstrates impressive performance metrics, achieving a training accuracy of 92.95% and a final training loss of 0.0632 after 2 epochs of training.

sources.title: my_awesome_model huggingface.co api & stevhliu my_awesome_model github ...
sources.snippet: my_awesome_model is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find my_awesome_model on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of my_awesome_model install, users can directly use my_awesome_model installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.

sources.title: my_awesome_eli5_clm-model API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Run my_awesome_eli5_clm-model with FriendliAI inference. This model is a fine-tuned version of distilbert/distilgpt2 on an unknown dataset.
